title: A game master travels from the Commons to Ravenwood through the loading screen, and a zone that does not exist is refused
notes: 6.07: two wizards enter the Commons as two-wizards.json has them and the main account is a game master. .tele zone to a path the
server does not hold is refused and the wizard stays. .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Ravenwood sends MSG_ZONETRANSFERREQUEST; the client acknowledges,
the game server takes the wizard out of the Commons, which the companion sees, writes Ravenwood's Start as its place and a single-use transfer key,
and sends MSG_SERVERTRANSFER; the client shows its loading screen, attaches again with the key and stands in Ravenwood.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
